dialogue.htmlContent:
Lying to the west of the Foloi Fields, the area known as the Shinrin Highlands is the home of the elusive youko. Many parts of this land are densely forested, with species of cypress, maple, cedar, pine, and cherry being the most common types of trees which you see. As if navigating around and through these forests wasn't challenging enough, the entire region consists of undulating terrain, which is sometimes punctuated by long, flat valleys.

Now and again, you manage to pick up a path, but these trails inevitably lead to dead-ends or simply disappear into the forest. Other than these tracks, you come across several other signs of habitation, the most common of which are rice fields surrounding the occasional Japanese-style farmhouse. Curiously enough, you never see anyone working in these fields or walking around near the farmhouses, and a chill sometimes runs down your spine as you look at these seemingly-deserted houses from afar.

#IF(game.getDialogueFlags().hasFlag(FLAG_hasSnowedThisWinter) && game.getSeason()==SEASON_WINTER)

The entire landscape is currently cloaked in a blanket of fresh, white snow, #IF(game.getCurrentWeather()==WEATHER_SNOW) and large snowflakes are currently drifting down from the clouds up above. #ELSE which crunches beneath your [pc.feet] as you [pc.walk] over hills and through silent woodland. #ENDIF

#ENDIF

[style.italicsMinorBad(Youko encounters in the Shinrin Highlands will be added in the next update.)]

Originating somewhere deep within the western Mountains of the Moon, the river Hubur cuts its path eastwards, passing through the Shinrin Highlands, the Foloi Fields, and Dominion itself before flowing out to sea. Although there's a well-maintained road which runs alongside the river through the Foloi Fields, this path degrades into little more than a dirt track when it reaches the Shinrin Highlands. #IF(pc.hasStatusEffect(SE_AQUATIC_POSITIVE)) This doesn't bother you much, as you prefer to shun the path and swim in the river instead. #ELSE It's down this poorly-maintained track which you currently find yourself travelling. #ENDIF

The youko of the Shinrin Highlands are known to attack travellers and use illusion spells to mislead them, so you make sure to keep an eye out for any sign of suspicious activity as you continue on your way. As it stands, however, the river and the surrounding banks are completely deserted. None of the boats and barges which travel between Elis, Dominion, and Lyonesse venture this far up the river, and as such you find yourself completely alone.

Constructed and maintained by the elusive youko, there are many wooden bridges which cross the river, #IF(pc.hasStatusEffect(SE_AQUATIC_POSITIVE)) but as you can simply swim across at any time you like, this doesn't really concern you. #ELSE so you never have to go far in order to cross over it to the other bank. #ENDIF

#IF(game.getDialogueFlags().hasFlag(FLAG_hasSnowedThisWinter) && game.getSeason()==SEASON_WINTER)

Thanks to the snow which #IF(game.getCurrentWeather()==WEATHER_SNOW) has not only covered the land, but which is also currently falling in big flurries, #ELSE has covered the land, #ENDIF the very edges of the river are currently frozen over in thick sheets of ice, although most of the centre is still running freely.

#ENDIF

[style.italicsMinorBad(Youko encounters in the Shinrin Highlands will be added in the next update.)]
